    • vulnerable

      IPlayerBuilder vulnerable()
      Allows ordinary server damage to affect the synthetic player.

      Synthetic players are invulnerable by default so unrelated survival mechanics cannot make tests nondeterministic. Use this opt-in for tests that explicitly exercise damage or death behavior.

      Returns:
      This builder.

    • withLocale

      IPlayerBuilder withLocale(String locale)
      Sets the client locale sent during the configuration phase of a full-login join (LK-12).

      Only meaningful with fullLogin(); ignored for the default legacy spawn path.

      Parameters:
      locale - Locale identifier such as "en_us"; must not be blank.
      Returns:
      This builder.

    • fullLogin

      IPlayerBuilder fullLogin()
      Joins the player through the full vanilla login pipeline over real loopback TCP.

      Behavioral differences from the default spawn: the real AsyncPlayerPreLoginEvent, PlayerLoginEvent, and PlayerJoinEvent fire; the server derives the offline UUID from the name (any builder UUID is ignored); and the join can be denied (whitelist/ban/full server), surfaced as a BotJoinDeniedException, or time out as a BotJoinTimeoutException.

      Returns:
      This builder.
